charts.title: K2-133 e: orbits around K2-133
charts.description: The orbits of K2-133's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-133 e highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Wells et al. 2019 (2019MNRAS.487.1865W), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname WELLS_ET_AL__2019): P 26.5841 d
